text:
maria: quick heads-up — proposing a staged 'safemode' pin for runtime v3.10 + SDK 1.8 for this week's canary window (Tue 15:00 UTC). reason: saw a perf regression in the quant path on long-seq tests; want a conservative rollout.

alex: any perf numbers? will this affect Dedicated pools?

samir: perf regression ~6-8% p99 for seq >4k on A100s; quant path only. Dedicated should be unaffected if we route them to runtime v3.9, but a few hosts already autoupgraded.

olivia: can we do a partial pin (10% traffic) + telemetry flag to watch quality? define clear rollback triggers?

maria: proposed plan: 10% canary for 2h, then 50% for 1h if no errors, then full roll. rollback triggers: >1.5% absolute increase in 5xx, >7% p95 latency regression vs baseline, or eval quality drift >2% fail.

samir: +1. also pin SDK 1.8 client-side to avoid hotpath mismatch. deploy-bot: please apply pinlist with safemode tag.

deploy-bot: scheduled pinlist change created by maria at 2026-03-20T10:05Z: /pins runtime=3.10:safemode sdk=1.8:safemode canary=10%

olivia: pls add a short note to release notes and ops runbook: include rollback command, dashboards to watch, and temporary autoscaler knobs.

maria: release-note draft: "Temporary safemode pin on runtime v3.10 and SDK 1.8 during canary due to long-sequence quant perf regression; staged rollout with automatic rollback conditions."

prod-oncall: oncall ack — I'll monitor the platform dashboards. customer comms?

alex: for Dedicated customers we'll send a targeted advisory: they can opt-out by setting runtime_version=3.9 until we lift the pin.

maria: can someone assemble the canary eval set for quality checks? olivia?

olivia: uploaded eval set 'longseq_quant_check_v3' to s3 (internal link). running baseline eval now.

deploy-bot: pin applied to canary group (10%) at 2469460000

maria: confirmed deployed to canary. watching logs / traces now. :eyes: 

samir: seeing a slight token throughput drop, but within expected bounds. continuing to watch telemetry.

maria: if 50% pass we plan to lift safemode after 24h and remove pin; otherwise rollback to 3.9.

olivia: added rollback steps to runbook snippet:

```
# rollback (ops runbook)
deploy-bot rollback runtime=3.9 --scope=all --reason="safemode rollback"
# revert sdk pin in releases table: UPDATE pins SET sdk=null WHERE tag='safemode';
```

alex: +1 on comms plan. i'll kick off overnight SDK compat tests against 1.8.

prod-oncall: posted a watch alert in #incidents if thresholds fire; i'll escalate if anything trips.

maria: thanks everyone. will post back after the 2h canary with metrics snapshot and decision.
